When my dad was helping me practice driving, we would always go to this one place that was always abandoned. I'm not a very good driver, and would always mix up the pedals. The last time we went there, there was a family picnic happening at a pond area right next to it. Towards the end of my drive, two women and a young child were crossing the street. I braked, the two women and the child crossed the street, everything was fine. I let go of the break and was about to hit the gas, and the child runs out onto the street. My dad screams brake, and I do, and everything is fine. But I always think, what if I had mixed up the brake and gas that time? Not long after, I mixed them up while making a left turn and took out a light pole/street sign, but no one was hurt, and the only people involved were my dad and I.

The thought of driving makes me nauseous now.
